notes: 1. Set VFO A Active in VFO Mode
--(It *will* work in channel mode if you are only using the default Mic Emulation PTT mode)
2. Best results Settings - (1) Radio Set - (4) Other Func - (6) Ana Sq Level to 0
3. Make sure Settings - (1) Radio Set - (1) Voice Func - (7) Speaker Mode is set to 1. Mic Spk or 3. Both
4. Start with volume on VFO A approximately 1/3 the way up
Do not enable VOX on radio, do not enable mic volt det (Leave as UART)
